hints.text: This clue's indicators are 'False', 'in which... appears', and 'finally'. One of these is an anagram indicator guiding us to mix up some neighbouring letters. Another is a selection indicator, identifying which letter or letters we need to select from an adjacent word. And a third is a containing indicator flagging that some fodder will appear inside other fodder.
This clue's fodder is 'image' and 'water'. We'll use these letters (or some of them) to construct our answer, as guided by our indicator(s).

This clue is an &lit, which means the whole clue is the definition and the whole clue is the wordplay. We've typically flagged our &lits using the !? punctuation, but we might drop that designation soon (see video). In this clue, our answer is a kind of false image in which water finally appears.
